title: NVIDIA's Jensen Huang makes a surprise return as CEO, reportedly influenced by US Trump administration lobbying
summary: Welcoming Huang's return from his resignation, high-tech stocks surged sharply on the Nikkei Stock Average and in the Tokyo and New York markets.

title: Russia's ally Tajikistan initiates procedures to withdraw from the ICC
summary: The country, which was not detained during President Putin's visit, is showing signs of aligning with Mr. Trump's intentions urging various nations to withdraw.

title: Six opposition parties to submit a censure motion against Minister of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Seki to the House of Councillors
summary: Amid fierce battles between the ruling and opposition parties over issues such as politics and money, the political future of the minister, who has denied resigning, has become the focus of attention.
